name: oc-ai-report
description: Cross-ticket AI-usage report over a period - AI-metrics JSON records (backend/frontend/QA) grouped by developer domain; per-area Architect estimate (custom fields) and Dev-lead estimate (ticket field / sum of child sub-task estimates); ticket type; bug counts and hours-logged-on-bugs per area; logged hours per user & ticket via the Tempo API (fallback Jira worklogs); time gain without/with bug hours; sections ordered Totals -> Summary -> Detail. Prints Markdown and writes a self-contained styled, date-stamped HTML file to ./docs/ai-usage-report-<date>.html. Reads Jira (Atlassian MCP) + optional Tempo (TEMPO_API_TOKEN).
